    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", len(customers))

            c += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
        return c

        demand = route_demand(ra2) + route_demand(rb2)
        if demand > capacity:
            return False

        merged = ra2 + rb2
        # replace in lower index to keep determinism

        routes[lo] = merged
        routes.pop(hi)
        return True

            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1], t[2]))

    # Helper to locate whether customer is at an end of its current route
    def find_route_endpos(rt, node):
        # returns (pos, is_head) where pos is 0 or -1 for head/tail
        if not rt:
            return None
        if rt[0] == node:
            return 0, True
        if rt[-1] == node:

        idx_j = cust_to_route.get(j, None)
